measurements.technique: Source text with explicit reported/model/context scope

value.value: Rigorously purify particle dispersions through six precipitation/resuspension cycles, drop on a diamond ATR cell, evaporate solvent and acquire using Nicolet 6700. Pure OA, oleylamine, dioctylamine, TOP and TOPO are cast from hexane/surfactant mixtures for comparison.
